name: Real time Air Quality Index from various locations
indicator: AQI, PM2.5, PM10, NO2, SO2, CO, O3 and other air pollutants
description: Provides real-time air-quality measurements from monitoring stations, with station, city, state and pollutant-level information useful for tracking Indian urban air pollution.
organization: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) via Open Government Data Platform India
notes: Official India dataset; hourly/live feed; suitable for dashboards and software integration.

name: ERA5 hourly data on single levels from 1940 to present
indicator: Temperature, precipitation, humidity, wind, pressure and other atmospheric variables
description: Global hourly climate reanalysis combining observations with a numerical weather model. Useful for long-term climate analysis and filling gaps where station data is unavailable.
organization: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) / ECMWF
coverage: Global; can be subset to India/Maharashtra
notes: Authoritative climate reanalysis; free with account; large files and preprocessing required.

name: NASA POWER Daily API
indicator: Temperature, relative humidity, precipitation, wind and solar/meteorological parameters
description: Returns daily meteorological and solar parameters for selected coordinates or regions. It is especially convenient for student software projects because values can be requested programmatically.
organization: NASA Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER)
coverage: Global; point/regional queries for India and Maharashtra
data_format: JSON / CSV / NetCDF / ASCII / ICASA; API
notes: Free NASA API; easy for backend integration; multiple output formats.

name: Location wise daily Ambient Air Quality of Maharashtra for the year 2005
indicator: SO2, NO2, RSPM and SPM ambient air quality
description: Daily ambient-air measurements from Maharashtra monitoring stations, with sampling date, location and station type. It is useful for historical air-pollution comparisons within the state.
organization: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) / Open Government Data Platform India
notes: Official Maharashtra-specific historical data; free/open under NDSAP. Field measurements may contain abnormal or instrumental values.

name: Sentinel-5P Level 2 Products
indicator: NO2, SO2, CO, O3, CH4, formaldehyde and aerosol index
description: Satellite observations of atmospheric trace gases and aerosols at high spatial and temporal resolution. It can be filtered to India or Maharashtra for air-quality and pollution mapping.
organization: Copernicus Sentinel-5P / European Space Agency (ESA)
notes: Open Copernicus satellite data; useful for pollutant maps. Quality flags and geospatial preprocessing are required.

name: CAMS global reanalysis (EAC4)
indicator: Carbon monoxide, ozone, aerosols, meteorology and atmospheric composition
description: A global 3-hourly atmospheric-composition reanalysis combining models and observations. It provides consistent long-term fields for air-quality and atmospheric studies.
organization: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) / ECMWF
coverage: Global; can be subset to India/Maharashtra
notes: 0.75° global grid; 3-hourly; CC-BY. Registration/login required for downloads; advanced preprocessing needed.

name: MERRA-2 instM_3d_asm_Np: 3d,Monthly mean,Instantaneous,Pressure-Level,Assimilation,Assimilated Meteorological Fields V5.12.4
indicator: Temperature, relative humidity, wind, pressure, water vapor and ozone
description: Monthly mean atmospheric reanalysis on 42 pressure levels. It is useful for long-term atmospheric structure, humidity, wind and ozone analysis.
organization: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO) / GES DISC
coverage: Global; can be subset to India/Maharashtra
notes: 0.5° × 0.625° monthly reanalysis; files are large; Earthdata login and preprocessing required.

name: ERA5-Land hourly time-series data from 1950 to present
indicator: Surface temperature, maximum/minimum temperature, precipitation, humidity, wind and land-surface variables
description: Hourly land-focused reanalysis time series at about 0.1° resolution. It is useful for long-term temperature, rainfall and other climate indicators for selected points in India or Maharashtra.
organization: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) / ECMWF
coverage: Global land areas; can be subset to India/Maharashtra
notes: Free Copernicus climate dataset; point time-series access is convenient, but registration and preprocessing may be required.

name: Climate Hazards InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS) Version 3
indicator: Rainfall / precipitation
description: High-resolution rainfall estimates combining satellite observations with station data. It is useful for rainfall variability, drought and extreme-precipitation analysis across India.
organization: Climate Hazards Center, University of California Santa Barbara
coverage: Quasi-global land areas, about 60°S–60°N; includes India/Maharashtra
notes: Free rainfall dataset; multiple temporal resolutions are available. Raster preprocessing is required for map-based use.

name: Global Historical Climatology Network daily (GHCNd)
indicator: Daily maximum/minimum temperature, precipitation, snowfall and snow depth
description: Quality-controlled daily station climate observations from more than 100,000 stations worldwide. Station records vary in length and can support historical climate and extreme-temperature analysis.
organization: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
coverage: Global, 180+ countries and territories; Indian stations included
time_period: Varies by station; records range from under 1 year to more than 175 years; updated daily
notes: Official NOAA station observations; strong for max/min temperature and rainfall. Station filtering and text-file preprocessing are required.

name: Global Historical Climatology Network hourly (GHCNh)
indicator: Hourly temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, visibility and precipitation
description: Hourly and synoptic land-station weather observations harmonized from meteorological networks worldwide. Useful for short-term weather, ground-sensor-like monitoring and extreme-event analysis.
organization: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
coverage: Global; Indian stations included where available
time_period: Historical to present; period varies by station
notes: Official NOAA hourly observations; useful for wind/humidity/temperature. Coverage and variables vary by station.

name: Global Historical Climatology Network monthly (GHCNm) Temperature, Version 4
indicator: Monthly land-surface air temperature
description: Quality-controlled monthly temperature records from land stations worldwide. It is useful for long-term warming trends and historical climate comparisons.
organization: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
time_period: Historical to present; period varies by station
notes: Good for long-term temperature trends; station-level text files require filtering and preprocessing.

name: International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship (IBTrACS) Version 4r01
indicator: Tropical cyclone tracks, wind speed, pressure and storm intensity
description: A unified global archive of historical and current tropical-cyclone best-track data. North Indian Ocean subsets make it useful for cyclone and extreme-weather monitoring relevant to India.
organization: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
coverage: Global; North Indian Ocean basin subset available
time_period: Historical records from the 19th century–present; continuously updated
notes: Open NOAA extreme-weather dataset; updated several times per week. Early pre-1950 records have known limitations.

name: MODIS/Terra Aerosol 5-Min L2 Swath 10 km (MOD04_L2)
indicator: Aerosol optical depth, aerosol properties and atmospheric particulate loading
description: Satellite-derived aerosol measurements that can complement ground PM2.5/PM10 observations and show regional aerosol loading over India.
organization: NASA LAADS DAAC / MODIS Terra
notes: Satellite aerosol product; not a direct PM2.5 ground measurement. Earthdata/LAADS access and geospatial preprocessing are required.

name: GLOBALVIEWplus Cooperative Global Atmospheric Data Integration Project: Carbon Dioxide (CO2)
indicator: Atmospheric CO2 observations
description: Integrated atmospheric CO2 measurements from many laboratories and monitoring sites worldwide. It supports atmospheric-carbon trends and comparison with the Mauna Loa benchmark.
organization: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory (GML) / ObsPack contributors
time_period: 1957–2024 where available; coverage varies by site and product release
notes: Authoritative multi-laboratory CO2 product; data-use and citation conditions apply, and site coverage varies.

name: Ground Water Level Data
indicator: Groundwater level / depth to water table
description: Seasonal groundwater-level measurements compiled from the national monitoring network. Useful for comparing groundwater conditions across states and over time.
organization: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB), Government of India
time_period: 1994–2024 seasonal compilations; latest year varies by measurement period
notes: Official India groundwater source; Maharashtra-specific records/compilations available; file format to verify before download.

name: Global Surface Water
indicator: Surface-water occurrence, seasonality, recurrence and long-term change
description: Satellite-derived maps showing where surface water occurs and how water presence has changed over decades. Useful for rivers, lakes, reservoirs and wetland change analysis.
organization: European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC)
notes: Open global satellite dataset; excellent for map visualization; geospatial preprocessing required.

name: GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 day 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07 (GPM_3IMERGDF)
indicator: Daily precipitation / rainfall
description: Provides daily satellite-based precipitation estimates on a global grid. Useful for rainfall, flood, drought and water-availability analysis where ground gauges are sparse.
organization: NASA Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC)
coverage: Global; can be subset to India/Maharashtra
notes: High-resolution precipitation product; Earthdata login may be required; preprocessing needed.

name: Daily data of reservoir level of Central Water Commission (CWC)
indicator: Reservoir level and water storage
description: Reservoir-level and storage information for reservoirs across India, with reservoir name, state, district, basin and sub-basin fields. Useful for water-availability monitoring.
organization: National Water Informatics Centre / Ministry of Jal Shakti; Central Water Commission data
data_format: Portal / ZIP download; resource format to verify
notes: Official high-value India water dataset; catalog updated 15 Feb 2026. Data API is not currently available on the resource page.

name: Water quality of river Panchganga and Bhima-2008
indicator: River water quality: temperature, DO, pH, conductivity, BOD, nitrate/nitrite and coliforms
description: Minimum, maximum and mean water-quality measurements for the Panchganga and Bhima river monitoring locations. It gives a useful Maharashtra-specific historical benchmark for river pollution.
organization: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) / Open Government Data Platform India
notes: Official Maharashtra river-water dataset from MINARS/CPCB; small and easy to use, but historical rather than current.

name: JPL GRACE and GRACE-FO Mascon Ocean, Ice, and Hydrology Equivalent Water Height Coastal Resolution Improvement (CRI) Filtered Release 06.3 Version 04
indicator: Terrestrial water storage and groundwater-related mass change
description: Monthly global water-storage and equivalent-water-height anomalies derived from GRACE and GRACE-FO gravity observations. Useful for broad groundwater and water-storage trend analysis.
organization: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) / PO.DAAC
notes: Monthly 0.5° product; recommended CRI solution for land hydrology. Earthdata login required for protected data access.

name: River discharge and related historical data from the Global Flood Awareness System
indicator: River discharge, runoff, root-zone soil wetness and snow water equivalent
description: Daily modelled hydrological time series on a global grid, including river discharge and runoff. Useful for flood, drought and river-flow analysis in India.
organization: Copernicus Emergency Management Service (CEMS) / ECMWF
notes: GloFAS v5.0 is 0.05° and updated daily. The API request structure changed in July 2026, so scripts must use the current request format.

name: Global Ocean Physics Reanalysis
indicator: Sea-surface/subsurface temperature, salinity, currents and sea level
description: A global ocean reanalysis providing 3D temperature, salinity, currents and sea-level fields. It directly supports the Ocean Health Monitoring and ocean-temperature parts of Gaia Goal.
organization: Copernicus Marine Service
coverage: Global oceans; Indian Ocean and Arabian Sea included
notes: Authoritative ocean reanalysis; strong for ocean-health dashboards. Large NetCDF files require preprocessing.

name: NOAA Daily Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature (OISST), Version 2.1
indicator: Daily sea surface temperature and sea-ice concentration
description: Daily global sea-surface temperature on a regular grid, combining satellite and in-situ observations. Useful for ocean warming, marine heat and Indian Ocean trend analysis.
organization: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
notes: Widely used climate-quality SST dataset; easy to map after NetCDF preprocessing.

name: Global Ocean Biogeochemistry Hindcast
indicator: Chlorophyll, oxygen, nitrate, phosphate, pH and carbon-system variables
description: Global biogeochemical ocean fields useful for tracking ocean productivity, oxygen conditions, nutrients and acidification. This strengthens Gaia Goal's Ocean Health Monitoring module.
organization: Copernicus Marine Service
notes: Advanced ocean-health dataset; useful for chlorophyll, oxygen and pH. Requires NetCDF/geospatial processing.

name: Global Ocean Gridded L4 Sea Surface Heights and Derived Variables Reprocessed
indicator: Sea level anomaly, absolute dynamic topography and geostrophic currents
description: Satellite-altimetry sea-level records and derived circulation variables. Useful for ocean-height trends, coastal climate context and marine monitoring.
organization: Copernicus Marine Service / multi-mission altimetry
notes: Good for sea-level trends and ocean maps; advanced geospatial format.

name: AQUASTAT - Water Resources, Withdrawals and Use
indicator: Water resources, freshwater withdrawal, irrigation and water use
description: Country-level water-resources and water-use indicators covering renewable water, withdrawals and sectoral use. Useful for India's water availability and consumption context.
organization: FAO AQUASTAT
time_period: Historical annual/periodic series; indicator coverage varies by country
notes: Official FAO water-use source; country-level rather than Maharashtra-level.

name: Aqueduct 4.0 Global Water Risk Indicators
indicator: Baseline water stress, drought risk, riverine flood risk and groundwater decline
description: Spatial water-risk indicators designed for comparing current and future water stress and water-related hazards. Useful for Gaia Goal's climate-risk heatmap.
organization: World Resources Institute (WRI) Aqueduct
coverage: Global; India and Maharashtra can be mapped
time_period: Current baseline plus future scenarios for 2030, 2050 and 2080
notes: Strong climate-risk source; some indicators are modeled rather than direct observations.

name: Global Ocean In Situ Biogeochemical Observations
indicator: Dissolved oxygen, nutrients, chlorophyll, carbon-system and other marine biogeochemical observations
description: In-situ ocean biogeochemical observations from floats, ships and monitoring programs. Useful for validating modeled ocean-health indicators.
organization: Copernicus Marine Service
coverage: Global oceans; Indian Ocean observations included where available
notes: Real observations rather than model-only data; spatial coverage is uneven.

name: Bhuvan Flood Hazard Layer
indicator: Flood hazard / historical inundation-prone areas
description: India-focused flood-hazard and thematic geospatial information from ISRO's Bhuvan platform. Useful for flood-event and climate-risk mapping.
organization: NRSC / ISRO Bhuvan
coverage: India; state-level mapping including Maharashtra where layers are available
time_period: Historical reference period varies by layer; verify before extraction
data_format: WMS/WMTS / geospatial download; exact file format to verify
notes: India-specific flood mapping source; exact layer vintage and downloadable format should be checked before ingestion.

name: MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 250m SIN Grid V061 (MOD13Q1)
indicator: NDVI, EVI and vegetation condition
description: Provides 16-day vegetation indices at 250 m resolution for monitoring vegetation health, greenness and seasonal change.
organization: NASA LP DAAC / MODIS
notes: 250 m resolution; strong for vegetation maps and time-series; geospatial preprocessing required.

name: Tree cover loss
indicator: Annual tree-cover loss / deforestation
description: Annual estimates of tree-cover loss that can be used to study deforestation trends and compare countries or regions.
organization: Global Forest Watch data, processed by Our World in Data
notes: Easy-to-use processed dataset; useful for rapid visualization; source methodology originates from Global Forest Watch.

name: GBIF occurrence data
indicator: Species occurrence / biodiversity records
description: Contains georeferenced species-observation and specimen records from institutions and biodiversity projects worldwide. Can be filtered to India, Maharashtra, species or date.
organization: Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF)
time_period: Varies by occurrence record; continuously updated
data_format: Darwin Core Archive / SIMPLE_CSV / Parquet; API
notes: Bulk downloads require a free GBIF account; excellent biodiversity coverage but records require quality filtering.

name: Normalised Difference Vegetation Index 2014-present (raster 300 m), global, 10-daily – version 3
indicator: NDVI / vegetation greenness
description: Global 10-day NDVI observations at about 300 m resolution, showing vegetation greenness and seasonal change. Useful for crop, vegetation-health and ecosystem monitoring.
organization: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS)
notes: Validated satellite product; updated regularly with near-real-time availability. Good for time-series vegetation dashboards.

name: Protected Planet - World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA) and OECMs
indicator: Protected areas, conservation sites and biodiversity protection
description: Global protected-area and OECM records with site locations and attributes. It can be filtered to India to evaluate conservation coverage and ecosystem protection.
organization: UNEP-WCMC / IUCN Protected Planet
notes: WDPA and WD-OECM were merged into one database in November 2025. API v4 is current; API key required and non-commercial-use conditions apply.

name: MCD64A1 - Combined Level 3 Direct Broadcast Burned Area Monthly Global 500m SIN Grid
indicator: Burned area and fire impact
description: Monthly 500 m MODIS burned-area maps that identify burn dates and quality information. Useful for studying wildfire impacts on vegetation and ecosystems.
organization: NASA LAADS DAAC / MODIS Terra+Aqua
notes: Monthly 500 m satellite product; HDF geospatial preprocessing is required. LAADS token/Earthdata access may be needed for automated downloads.

name: Land Surface Phenology 2014-present (raster 300 m), global, yearly – version 2
indicator: Growing-season timing, season length and vegetation productivity
description: Yearly 300 m vegetation phenology and productivity metrics, including start/end of season, season length and seasonal productivity. Useful for ecosystem and agricultural-season analysis.
organization: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS)
notes: Validated open satellite product; 300 m yearly metrics. Useful for long-term seasonal vegetation changes.

name: Global Forest Resources Assessment (FRA) 2025 Data
indicator: Forest area, forest change, growing stock and forest-management indicators
description: Country-level forest statistics compiled for the FAO Global Forest Resources Assessment. Useful for India's forest-cover and long-term forest-change comparisons.
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
time_period: 1990–2025 for many core indicators; exact period varies by variable
notes: Official FAO forest assessment; country-level rather than Maharashtra-level. Strong for deforestation/forest-cover context.

name: IUCN Red List Spatial Data
indicator: Species ranges, threatened species and conservation status
description: Spatial distribution data for assessed species together with Red List conservation status. Useful for biodiversity-index and threatened-species mapping.
organization: International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) Red List
coverage: Global; India included where species maps are available
time_period: Current database with assessment dates varying by species
notes: Authoritative biodiversity source. Terms of use apply; not every species has downloadable spatial data.

name: Living Planet Index Database
indicator: Population abundance trends for vertebrate species
description: Time-series records of monitored wildlife populations used to derive the Living Planet Index. Useful for biodiversity trend analysis beyond simple species occurrence.
organization: Zoological Society of London (ZSL) / Living Planet Index
coverage: Global; records include India where monitoring data exist
notes: Useful for biodiversity trends; coverage is uneven across regions and species.

name: MCD15A3H MODIS/Terra+Aqua Leaf Area Index/FPAR 4-Day L4 Global 500m
indicator: Leaf Area Index (LAI) and Fraction of Photosynthetically Active Radiation (FPAR)
description: Satellite vegetation-structure and photosynthetic-activity indicators at 500 m resolution. Useful for ecosystem productivity and agricultural-vegetation monitoring.
organization: NASA LAADS DAAC / MODIS Terra+Aqua
notes: Useful vegetation biophysical product; Earthdata/LAADS access and raster preprocessing required.

name: MOD17A3HGF MODIS/Terra Net Primary Production Gap-Filled Yearly L4 Global 500m
indicator: Net primary productivity (NPP)
description: Annual satellite-derived vegetation productivity estimates showing the net carbon gained by vegetation. Useful for ecosystem-health and carbon-cycle analysis.
organization: NASA LP DAAC / MODIS
notes: Strong ecosystem-productivity indicator; advanced raster processing required.

name: Leaf Area Index 2014-present, global, 300 m
indicator: Leaf Area Index
description: Copernicus global vegetation LAI at 300 m, useful for vegetation-density, crop and ecosystem monitoring at regular intervals.
organization: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS)
notes: Open Copernicus vegetation product; easier for ecosystem time-series but still requires geospatial processing.

name: Dry Matter Productivity 2014-present, global, 300 m
indicator: Dry matter productivity / vegetation productivity
description: Global satellite-based vegetation dry-matter productivity, useful for monitoring biomass production, crop performance and ecosystem condition.
organization: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS)
notes: Useful complement to NDVI/LAI; modeled satellite product and preprocessing required.

name: Global Forest Change 2000–2024
indicator: Tree cover, annual tree-cover loss and forest gain
description: High-resolution satellite maps of tree cover and annual tree-cover loss. It supports deforestation monitoring at subnational scale, including Maharashtra.
organization: University of Maryland / Global Forest Watch
coverage: Global; India and Maharashtra can be subset
notes: Strong for deforestation maps; high-resolution files can be large and require GIS processing.

name: SoilGrids 2.0
indicator: Soil organic carbon, pH, texture, bulk density, nitrogen, CEC and related soil properties
description: Global 250 m gridded predictions of key soil properties at multiple standard soil depths, including uncertainty estimates.
organization: ISRIC – World Soil Information
time_period: 2020 release/current product; not a temporal time series
notes: CC BY 4.0; 250 m; complete maps are very large. WCS is useful for spatial subsets; REST API availability may be intermittent.

name: SMAP L3 Radiometer Global Daily 36 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture V009 (SPL3SMP)
indicator: Surface soil moisture
description: Daily satellite-derived global soil-moisture observations suitable for monitoring wetness, drought conditions and land-surface water status.
organization: NASA NSIDC DAAC / SMAP
notes: Daily Earth-observation dataset; Earthdata access; advanced geospatial preprocessing likely required.

name: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200
indicator: Land use / land cover, cropland, built-up land, tree cover and other land classes
description: A global 10 m land-cover map derived from Sentinel satellite data. Useful for urban expansion, agricultural land and land-cover analysis.
organization: European Space Agency (ESA) WorldCover
notes: 10 m resolution; excellent for maps; tiled geospatial data requires preprocessing.

name: Land Use Land Cover (1:250000) - Bhuvan Thematic
indicator: Land use / land cover, agricultural land and urban land
description: India-wide land-use/land-cover thematic layers for multiple years. They support analysis of land conversion, agriculture, forest/land classes and urban expansion.
organization: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) / ISRO Bhuvan
data_format: WMS / Bhuvan data download; file format to verify
notes: India-specific official geospatial source; 1:250,000 series provides data for download and WMS access. Bhuvan registration may be required for some downloads.

name: Land Degradation (1:50000) - Bhuvan Thematic
indicator: Land degradation / degraded land
description: Official India land-degradation thematic layers for two reference periods. Useful for comparing degraded-land extent and linking it with land-use and soil indicators.
organization: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) / ISRO Bhuvan
data_format: WMS / WMTS; downloadable format to verify
notes: India-specific official geospatial layers at 1:50,000 scale; metadata/statistics available. Download method/file format should be checked before ingestion.

name: MCD12Q1 - MODIS/Terra+Aqua Land Cover Type Yearly L3 Global 500m SIN Grid
indicator: Annual land-cover classes
description: Yearly 500 m global land-cover classifications from MODIS. Useful for long-term comparison of vegetation, cropland, built land and other land-cover changes.
organization: NASA LAADS DAAC / MODIS Terra+Aqua
notes: Annual 500 m product with multiple land-cover classification schemes; Earthdata/LAADS access and geospatial preprocessing required.

name: Soil moisture gridded data from 1978 to present
indicator: Surface soil moisture, root-zone soil moisture and freeze/thaw state
description: Global gridded surface and root-zone soil-moisture observations at 0.25° resolution. Useful for drought, agriculture and land-surface water analysis.
organization: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S)
notes: Daily, 10-day and monthly products; root-zone series starts in 1980. Large climate dataset; preprocessing required.

name: NASA Shuttle Radar Topography Mission Global 1 arc second (SRTMGL1)
indicator: Elevation / terrain
description: Near-global digital elevation data at about 30 m resolution. Useful for terrain, watershed, erosion and land-risk analysis.
organization: NASA / USGS LP DAAC
coverage: Near-global land areas; includes India and Maharashtra
notes: Free elevation data; useful as a base layer for land and hydrology maps. Requires GIS preprocessing.

name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
indicator: Digital elevation model / terrain height
description: Global 30 m digital elevation model derived from satellite radar data. Useful for terrain, slope and watershed analysis.
organization: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem / European Commission
notes: High-quality global DEM; geospatial tiles require preprocessing.

name: Harmonized World Soil Database Version 2.0
indicator: Soil type, texture, organic carbon, pH, bulk density and soil properties
description: A global harmonized soil database combining soil mapping units with physical and chemical properties. Useful for broad soil-quality and soil-type analysis.
organization: FAO / IIASA
time_period: Version 2.0 released 2023; source surveys span multiple years
notes: Global soil reference database; not a temporal time series. Requires GIS/database processing.

name: WISE30sec Global Soil Profile Database
indicator: Soil organic carbon, pH, texture, bulk density and nutrient-related properties
description: Global gridded soil-property estimates linked to soil profiles at approximately 30 arc-second resolution.
organization: ISRIC – World Soil Information
time_period: Static soil-property product; source observations span multiple decades
notes: Useful complementary soil database; not a time series and may require substantial preprocessing.

name: Global Soil Erosion Modelling (GloSEM)
indicator: Soil erosion by water
description: Modeled global soil-erosion estimates that help identify erosion hotspots and land-degradation risk.
organization: European Soil Data Centre (ESDAC) / Joint Research Centre (JRC)
time_period: Reference years/scenarios vary by GloSEM version; verify selected layer before use
notes: Strong land-degradation indicator; modeled rather than direct observation. Exact version/year should be fixed during download phase.

name: Wastelands Atlas / Bhuvan Wasteland Thematic Layers
indicator: Wasteland / degraded land classes
description: India-focused thematic layers showing wasteland categories and degraded land, useful for land-degradation and desertification-related analysis.
organization: NRSC / ISRO Bhuvan
time_period: Multiple reference periods; verify selected layer before use
notes: India-specific land-degradation source; exact edition and format should be confirmed when downloading.

name: Geomorphology (1:50000) - Bhuvan Thematic
indicator: Landform / geomorphology
description: India-wide geomorphological mapping useful for understanding terrain, erosion susceptibility, drainage and land processes.
organization: NRSC / ISRO Bhuvan
time_period: Reference period varies by mapping project
notes: Useful supporting landform layer; not itself a time-series climate dataset.

name: Land cover (Global, National - Annual) - FAOSTAT
indicator: Land-cover classes, cropland, tree-covered areas, built-up and other land-cover areas
description: Harmonized annual country-level land-cover statistics derived from established global satellite land-cover products. Useful for long-term land-cover change and agricultural/urban land context.
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) - FAOSTAT
time_period: 1992–2023 overall dissemination; exact coverage varies by underlying land-cover product
notes: CC BY 4.0; compiled from ESA CCI, MODIS, Copernicus Global Land Service and WorldCover products.

name: Randolph Glacier Inventory - A Dataset of Global Glacier Outlines, Version 7
indicator: Glacier outlines, glacier area and geometry
description: A globally complete inventory of glacier outlines and attributes. Useful for studying Himalayan glacier extent and comparing glacierized regions.
organization: NSIDC / Global Land Ice Measurements from Space community
coverage: Global; includes Himalayan glaciers affecting India
time_period: 1950–2021 source imagery/records; inventory represents an approximately year-2000 snapshot
notes: Open glacier inventory; strong for GIS visualization and Himalayan glacier analysis.

name: MODIS/Terra Snow Cover Daily L3 Global 500m SIN Grid, Version 61 (MOD10A1)
indicator: Daily snow cover / snow extent
description: Daily 500 m satellite snow-cover information useful for tracking seasonal snow extent, especially across mountainous and Himalayan regions.
organization: NASA NSIDC DAAC / MODIS
coverage: Global; includes Himalayan and Indian mountain regions
notes: 500 m daily product; useful for cryosphere maps; cloud cover and geospatial preprocessing must be considered.

name: GLIMS Glacier Database, Version 1
indicator: Glacier outlines and multi-temporal glacier observations
description: Stores glacier outlines and related observations from many dates, allowing glacier-change studies beyond a single inventory snapshot.
organization: Global Land Ice Measurements from Space (GLIMS) / NSIDC
source_url: GLIMS Glacier Database, Version 1 | National Snow and Ice Data Center
notes: Multi-temporal glacier database; useful for long-term glacier-change analysis; GIS processing required.

name: Himalayan Glacial Lakes Information System - Glacial Lake Database
indicator: Glacial lakes, lake area, type, elevation and GLOF-related attributes
description: A geospatial inventory of glacial lakes larger than 0.25 ha across Indian Himalayan river basins, with about 22 hydrological, geographical and administrative attributes.
organization: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC) / ISRO under National Hydrology Project
coverage: Indian Himalayan river basins; Indus, Ganga and Brahmaputra catchments
time_period: NHP inventory; source observation dates to verify
data_format: Geospatial database / Bhuvan download; exact file format to verify
notes: India-specific; 28,043 lakes ≥0.25 ha mapped. Free-download database is available; Bhuvan registration is required for the NHP download module.

name: IMS Daily Northern Hemisphere Snow and Ice Analysis at 1 km, 4 km, and 24 km Resolutions, Version 1
indicator: Snow cover and ice extent
description: Daily Northern Hemisphere snow-cover and ice maps derived from multiple satellites and in-situ data. Useful for Himalayan snow monitoring at several resolutions.
organization: U.S. National Ice Center / National Snow and Ice Data Center (NSIDC)
coverage: Northern Hemisphere; includes Himalayan and Indian mountain regions
notes: Daily operational product at 1 km, 4 km and 24 km resolutions. Suitable for snow-cover time series; operational availability is not guaranteed.

name: Glacier mass change gridded data from 1976 to present derived from the Fluctuations of Glaciers Database
indicator: Annual glacier mass change and mass-balance uncertainty
description: Annual gridded glacier mass-change estimates on a 0.5° global grid, combining WGMS glacier measurements and elevation-change observations.
organization: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) / World Glacier Monitoring Service (WGMS)
coverage: Global; includes Himalayan glaciers where observations are represented
notes: Annual 0.5° climate dataset; useful for glacier-change trends, but spatial detail is relatively coarse.

name: Snow cover extent from 1982 to present derived from satellite observations
indicator: Snow-cover fraction / snow extent
description: Global daily snow-cover fraction from optical satellite observations, including viewable snow and estimated ground snow beneath forest canopy.
organization: Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) / ENVEO IT GmbH
coverage: Global; includes India and the Himalayas
notes: Daily climate record; 0.05° resolution for 1982–2000 and 0.01° from 2000 onward; updated quarterly.

name: ATLAS/ICESat-2 L3A Land Ice Height, Version 7 (ATL06)
indicator: Glacier/land-ice surface elevation
description: Geolocated land-ice surface heights from ICESat-2 laser altimetry. It is useful for detecting glacier-height change and long-term ice loss.
organization: NASA NSIDC DAAC / ICESat-2
notes: 91-day repeat cycle; Earthdata login required. Strong for glacier-height trends but advanced processing is needed.

name: High Mountain Asia Gridded Glacier Thickness Change from Multi-Sensor DEMs, Version 1
indicator: Glacier thickness change
description: 30 m gridded thickness-change estimates for hundreds of Himalayan glaciers from historical and modern DEMs. Highly relevant to Indian Himalayan glacier-melt analysis.
organization: NASA NSIDC DAAC
coverage: High Mountain Asia / Himalayas, including Indian Himalayan region
notes: 30 m resolution; Earthdata login required. Excellent India/Himalaya-specific glacier-change source.

name: High Mountain Asia Average Glacier Thickness Change from Multi-Sensor DEMs, Version 1
indicator: Average glacier thickness change
description: Glacier-level average thickness-change estimates for Himalayan glaciers, providing simpler summary values than the gridded product.
organization: NASA NSIDC DAAC
coverage: High Mountain Asia / Himalayas, including Indian Himalaya
notes: Useful for glacier-level summaries and maps; Earthdata login required.

name: Global Land Ice Velocity Extraction from Landsat 8 (GoLIVE), Version 2
indicator: Glacier velocity / ice motion
description: Satellite-derived ice-velocity maps for permanent land ice, useful for studying glacier-flow changes and identifying dynamically active glaciers.
organization: NASA NSIDC DAAC / Landsat 8
coverage: Global land ice 82°S–82°N; Himalayan glaciers included
notes: 300 m, 16-day product; useful for glacier motion. Archived dataset, so pair with newer ITS_LIVE records.

name: MEaSUREs ITS_LIVE Regional Glacier and Ice Sheet Surface Velocities, Version 2
indicator: Annual glacier surface velocity
description: Regional annual surface-velocity mosaics derived from Landsat and Sentinel imagery. Useful for multi-decadal glacier-flow trends.
organization: NASA NSIDC DAAC / ITS_LIVE
coverage: Major global glacier regions; High Mountain Asia included
notes: Nearly complete annual coverage after 2013; excellent for glacier-motion trends, but files are geospatial and large.

name: High Mountain Asia Near-Global Multi-Decadal Glacial Lake Inventory, Version 1
indicator: Glacial lake area and change
description: Multi-decadal glacial-lake inventory useful for monitoring lake growth and glacier-lake hazards across High Mountain Asia.
organization: NASA NSIDC DAAC
coverage: High Mountain Asia; Himalayan regions included
time_period: Multi-decadal historical inventory; exact observation dates vary by mapped lake
notes: Useful for glacial-lake expansion and GLOF-risk analysis; Earthdata access/citation requirements apply.

name: High Mountain Asia Rasterized PyGEM Glacier Projections with RCP Scenarios, Version 1
indicator: Projected glacier mass balance, glacier runoff and glacier change
description: Modeled glacier projections under climate scenarios, useful for Gaia Goal's AI prediction and climate-risk modules.
organization: NASA NSIDC DAAC / PyGEM
coverage: High Mountain Asia, including Himalayan region
notes: Projection dataset rather than observations; 0.1° monthly outputs and Earthdata login required.

name: ATLAS/ICESat-2 L3A Sea Ice Height, Version 7 (ATL07)
indicator: Sea-ice elevation / height
description: ICESat-2 along-track sea-ice and sea-surface height measurements. It broadens the cryosphere catalogue beyond Himalayan glaciers for global comparison.
organization: NASA NSIDC DAAC / ICESat-2
notes: Useful mainly for global cryosphere comparison rather than India. Earthdata login and advanced processing required.

name: WorldPop Global2 Population Counts
indicator: Population count / population density / human pressure
description: High-resolution gridded population estimates that can be used to relate human concentration and growth to land, air, water and climate impacts.
organization: WorldPop
coverage: Global; India available at high spatial resolution
notes: Open gridded population data; useful for spatial overlays. Global2 covers 2015–2030 and includes projection years.

name: State/UT-wise Total Registered Motor Vehicles in India during 2001-2012
indicator: Registered motor vehicles / transportation pressure
description: State-wise historical counts of registered motor vehicles, useful as a proxy for transport growth, fuel use and emissions pressure.
organization: Open Government Data Platform India / Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
notes: Official India historical transport indicator; useful for trend context but not current vehicle stock. File format to verify.

name: Urban population (% of total population)
indicator: Urbanization / share of population living in urban areas
description: Annual country-level urban-population share, useful for comparing urbanization with environmental pressure and emissions trends.
organization: World Bank World Development Indicators; source: UN Population Division
time_period: Latest available through 2025; historical start varies by economy
notes: CC BY 4.0; easy country-level comparison and API integration; not district-level.

name: GHS-BUILT-S R2023A - GHS built-up surface spatial raster dataset, derived from Sentinel-2 composite (2018) and Landsat, multitemporal (1975-2030)
indicator: Built-up surface / urban expansion
description: Global gridded built-up surface estimates at multiple resolutions and five-year epochs. Useful for measuring urban expansion and related human pressure on land and climate.
organization: European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC) - Global Human Settlement Layer
notes: Free/open GHSL product; 100 m, 1 km and other grid options. Later epochs include projections and geospatial preprocessing is required.

name: State/UTs-wise Municipal Solid Waste Management (in reply to Unstarred Question on 21 March, 2022)
indicator: Municipal solid waste generation and management
description: State/UT-level municipal solid-waste information from an official parliamentary reply. It can be used to compare waste-management pressure across India including Maharashtra.
organization: Government of India / Rajya Sabha via Open Government Data Platform India
notes: Official India waste indicator. Resource exists on OGD; verify the downloadable file format and exact fields before ingestion.

name: State/UTs-wise Total Fertilizer Consumption from 2019-20 to 2021-22
indicator: Fertilizer consumption / agricultural input pressure
description: State-level fertilizer consumption in lakh metric tonnes for three financial years. Useful as an agricultural-intensity indicator linked to soil, water and greenhouse-gas impacts.
organization: Rajya Sabha / mFMS portal via Open Government Data Platform India
notes: Small official India dataset; easy to integrate. Values are reported in lakh metric tonnes.

name: Electric power consumption (kWh per capita)
indicator: Electricity consumption per capita / energy demand
description: Annual country-level electricity consumption per person, useful as a human-activity and energy-demand indicator for environmental and emissions analysis.
organization: World Bank World Development Indicators; source: International Energy Agency (IEA)
notes: CC BY 4.0; easy download/API integration. India is country-level rather than Maharashtra-specific.

name: Basic Population Figures of India/State/District/Sub-District/Village - 2011
indicator: Population, rural/urban population, households and workforce indicators
description: Official Census 2011 population figures from national to village level. It provides detailed human-population context that can be linked to environmental pressure and exposure.
organization: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India
coverage: India; state, district, sub-district and village level including Maharashtra
notes: Official India census source; highly useful for district-level population and human-pressure mapping.

name: State/UT-wise Total Number of Factories as per the Published Reports of Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) Data from 2018-19 to 2022-23
indicator: Number of factories / industrial activity
description: State-wise counts of registered factories from the Annual Survey of Industries, useful as a proxy for industrial activity and related environmental pressure.
organization: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation / Open Government Data Platform India
notes: Official India industrial indicator; useful for comparing human/industrial pressure across states.

name: State/UT-wise Road length per 1000 population for different Categories of Roads
indicator: Road density / transport infrastructure
description: State-wise road length normalized by population across road categories. It provides a transport-infrastructure indicator linked to mobility, land use and emissions.
organization: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways / Open Government Data Platform India
notes: Official transport indicator; historical snapshot rather than a continuous current series.

name: GHS-SMOD R2023A - GHS Settlement Layers
indicator: Degree of urbanisation, settlement classes and urban/rural structure
description: Global settlement classification into urban centres, urban clusters and rural grid cells. It supports urbanisation and human-settlement mapping for India and Maharashtra.
organization: European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC) - Global Human Settlement Layer
time_period: 1975–2030 at 5-year epochs; future epochs are projections
notes: Open GHSL dataset; 1 km settlement classes. Useful for urban growth and exposure analysis.

name: VNP46A3 - VIIRS/NPP Lunar BRDF-Adjusted Nighttime Lights Monthly L3 Global 15 arc second Linear Lat Lon Grid
indicator: Nighttime lights / human activity and infrastructure intensity
description: Monthly satellite nighttime-light radiance, useful as a spatial proxy for human activity, electrification, urbanisation and infrastructure intensity.
organization: NASA LAADS DAAC / VIIRS Black Marble
notes: Useful spatial proxy rather than a direct socioeconomic measure; Earthdata/LAADS access and raster preprocessing required.

name: Land use (Global, National - Annual) - FAOSTAT
indicator: Agricultural land, cropland, permanent meadows/pastures and land-use indicators
description: Annual country-level land-use statistics useful for tracking agricultural expansion and changes in human land use.
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) - FAOSTAT
time_period: 1961–2023 for core land-use series; coverage varies by item
notes: Official FAOSTAT data; easy to integrate for national agricultural-land trends.

name: Pesticides use (Global, National - Annual) - FAOSTAT
indicator: Agricultural pesticide use
description: Annual national pesticide-use statistics, useful as an agricultural-intensity and potential soil/water-pressure indicator.
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) - FAOSTAT
notes: Official FAOSTAT agricultural-input dataset; country-level rather than state-level.

name: Year-wise Share of Renewable Energy Generation in Maharashtra from 2021-22 to 2024-25
indicator: Renewable-energy generation and Maharashtra share
description: Year-wise renewable-energy generation for Maharashtra and its share of India's renewable generation, useful for tracking cleaner-energy transition.
organization: Central Electricity Authority data via Rajya Sabha / Open Government Data Platform India
notes: Maharashtra-specific official data; figures reported in billion units. Useful for energy/climate dashboards.

name: EDGAR_2025: GHG and CO2 emissions time-series
indicator: CO2, greenhouse-gas and sector-wise emissions
description: Country and sector emission time series for major greenhouse gases and CO2, suitable for analysing India’s historical emissions and sector contributions.
organization: European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC) – EDGAR
notes: Authoritative emissions inventory; useful for India and sector comparisons; spreadsheet format is easy to preprocess.

name: Our World in Data CO2 and Greenhouse Gas Emissions dataset
indicator: Annual CO2, per-capita CO2, cumulative and consumption-based emissions, GHGs, energy and carbon-intensity metrics
description: A regularly updated country-year dataset combining major carbon and greenhouse-gas indicators in one software-friendly table.
organization: Our World in Data (compiled from Global Carbon Project and other authoritative sources)
time_period: Historical series to latest available; period varies by indicator
notes: Very convenient for software integration and visualization; includes a codebook and many normalized indicators.

name: Total greenhouse gas emissions excluding LULUCF (Mt CO2e)
indicator: Total greenhouse-gas emissions excluding land-use change and forestry
description: Annual country-level greenhouse-gas emissions in Mt CO2e, useful for direct India-versus-country comparisons and API-based charts.
organization: World Bank World Development Indicators; source data from EDGAR/JRC and IEA
notes: CC BY 4.0; easy API/download access. Overlaps partly with EDGAR but is simpler for country-level integration.

name: Global Carbon Budget v2025
indicator: Fossil CO2 emissions, land-use change emissions and global carbon budget components
description: The latest Global Carbon Budget spreadsheet plus national fossil and land-use-change emissions. Useful for historical carbon trends, country comparisons and global carbon-cycle context.
organization: Global Carbon Project
time_period: Historical series through 2024; exact start varies by component
notes: Official 2025 GCB data hub; includes national spreadsheets and gridded NetCDF products. Check dataset-specific fair-use/citation statements.

name: Trends in Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide (CO2) - Mauna Loa CO2 records
indicator: Atmospheric CO2 concentration and growth rate
description: Daily, weekly, monthly and annual atmospheric CO2 records from Mauna Loa, forming the longest direct benchmark record of atmospheric CO2 concentration.
organization: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory (GML)
coverage: Mauna Loa, Hawaii; global climate benchmark
notes: Free authoritative benchmark for atmospheric CO2; not India-specific. NOAA measurements began in 1974, with the combined record extending to 1958.

name: FAOSTAT Emissions Totals
indicator: Agrifood-system greenhouse gas emissions, CO2, CH4 and N2O
description: Country, regional and global greenhouse-gas emissions across farm-gate, land-use-change and pre/post-production components. Useful for India’s agriculture-related carbon footprint.
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) - FAOSTAT
notes: Official FAO annual emissions statistics covering more than 200 countries and territories. Useful for agriculture and land-use emissions.

name: Our World in Data Energy dataset
indicator: Energy consumption, fossil fuels, renewables, electricity mix and energy intensity
description: A country-year dataset combining major energy consumption and energy-mix indicators in software-friendly formats. Useful for linking energy use to carbon emissions and climate trends.
organization: Our World in Data (compiled from Energy Institute, Ember, EIA and other sources)
time_period: Historical series to latest available; start varies by metric
notes: Regularly updated with a codebook; easy for software integration. Electricity metrics include data through 2024 in the current release.

name: Carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions excluding LULUCF per capita (t CO2e/capita)
indicator: CO2 emissions per capita
description: Annual country-level CO2 emissions per person excluding land-use, land-use change and forestry. Useful for comparing India's per-capita carbon footprint with other countries.
organization: World Bank World Development Indicators; source data from EDGAR/JRC and IEA
notes: Easy-to-integrate per-capita carbon indicator; complements absolute emissions already in the sheet.

name: Methane (CH4) emissions (total) excluding LULUCF (Mt CO2e)
indicator: Methane emissions
description: Annual national methane emissions in million tonnes CO2 equivalent, excluding LULUCF. Useful for tracking an important non-CO2 greenhouse gas.
organization: World Bank World Development Indicators; source data from EDGAR/JRC and IEA
notes: Directly supports methane monitoring and greenhouse-gas analytics; simple country-level API access.

name: Nitrous oxide (N2O) emissions (total) excluding LULUCF (Mt CO2e)
indicator: Nitrous oxide emissions
description: Annual national N2O emissions expressed as CO2 equivalent, excluding LULUCF. Useful for agriculture- and fertilizer-related climate analysis.
organization: World Bank World Development Indicators; source data from EDGAR/JRC and IEA
notes: Useful non-CO2 GHG indicator; easy for country comparisons and time-series charts.

name: Carbon dioxide (CO2) net fluxes from LULUCF - Total excluding non-tropical fires (Mt CO2e)
indicator: Land-use and forestry CO2 net fluxes
description: Annual national net CO2 fluxes associated with land use, land-use change and forestry. It connects forest/land changes with the carbon cycle.
organization: World Bank World Development Indicators; source data from EDGAR/JRC
notes: Useful link between deforestation/land-use change and carbon emissions; country-level series.

name: Temperature change on land (Global, National - Annual) - FAOSTAT
indicator: Mean surface temperature change / anomaly
description: Annual country-level mean land-surface temperature change relative to a climatological baseline. Useful for historical climate trends and India-focused warming indicators.
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) - FAOSTAT
notes: Official FAOSTAT climate indicator; annual updates and software-friendly resources are available.

name: ND-GAIN Country Index
indicator: Climate vulnerability and adaptation readiness
description: A country-level index combining vulnerability to climate change with readiness to improve resilience. Useful for Gaia Goal's Climate Risk Heatmap.
organization: University of Notre Dame Global Adaptation Initiative (ND-GAIN)
time_period: More than two decades of annual index data; latest year varies by release
notes: Useful composite climate-risk/adaptation indicator; country-level, not Maharashtra-specific.

name: SDG Indicator 13.2.2 - Total greenhouse gas emissions per year
indicator: SDG 13 greenhouse-gas emissions indicator
description: Official UN Sustainable Development Goal indicator for total annual greenhouse-gas emissions. It directly supports the Gaia Goal SDG 13 Progress Tracker.
organization: United Nations Statistics Division / UN SDG Global Database
coverage: Global country reporting; India included where data are reported
time_period: Time coverage varies by country and reported series
notes: Official SDG 13 source; includes variants with/without LULUCF depending on series. Best used for progress-tracker metadata and reporting.

name: Total greenhouse gas emissions per capita excluding LULUCF (t CO2e/capita)
indicator: Total GHG emissions per capita
description: Annual total greenhouse-gas emissions per person excluding LULUCF. Useful for normalized country comparisons and carbon-intensity-style dashboard views.
organization: World Bank World Development Indicators; source data from EDGAR/JRC and IEA
notes: Complements absolute total GHG values already present by normalizing emissions per person.
